concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-005 (Runtime Measurement) has no corresponding task. The plan explicitly lists T017 'Measure Runtime' to verify SC-005, but tasks.md Phase 4/5 contains no task to record wall-clock time or compare it against the 300-minute limit. This leaves a spec requirement unimplemented.

Plan Task T004 'Construct Validity Gate' (verifying dataset contains specific columns and ROI bounding boxes) is missing from tasks.md. While T005b verifies the URL source, no task exists to validate the internal schema (headline_text, belief_rating, ROI boxes) required before processing, leaving a critical data integrity gate uncovered.

Plan Task T016 'Generate Causal Framing Statement' is missing from tasks.md. While T028 exists, it is described as generating a 'hardcoded' statement regardless of p-values (a flaw noted in the analyze report), but the specific task to 'Explicitly frame findings as causal or associational based on dataset design' as defined in the plan is not clearly mapped or implemented correctly to satisfy FR-006 without violating Outcome-Neutral Validation.
Plan Task T007 'Data Quality Report' (SC-001) is missing. T014 filters participants, but no task is defined to generate the summary report of excluded participants required by SC-001 and the plan.

Plan Task T019 'Stability Check' (verifying coefficient sign and CI overlap) is missing. T032 and T038 handle the sweep and threshold stability, but the specific verification of coefficient sign/CI overlap across thresholds (T019) is not explicitly assigned a task.

Task T005b 'verify_dataset_source.py' appears to be a stale or redundant artifact. The plan does not list a separate verification script task; T002 (Checksum) and T004 (Validity Gate) cover the necessary hygiene. T005b duplicates logic within T005 and creates an orphan artifact not traced to a specific plan requirement.

Task T028 description contradicts the plan's T016 intent. The plan requires framing based on design (FR-006), but T028 is described as generating a statement 'regardless of p-values' which risks violating Outcome-Neutral Validation (Constitution VII). The task needs rewording to align with the plan's 'Explicitly frame findings... based on dataset design' without enforcing a conclusion independent of the data.
